Access from each background (0–10): ● ≥7.5 is a high-volume corridor (about 6–8 months at 15–20 hours a week), ◐ 4–7.4 is plausible but extended, ○ below 4 is not plausible within 12 months. These timelines are model outputs (Grade D). For the modelled time to a first offer and the best targets by background, see [GenAI target roles §5](../genai-target-roles.md#5-best-targets-by-background-genai-persona-lenses).

## What you need

- **Must (headline):** Python (production), LLM APIs & tool calling, Internal tooling & DevEx, OAuth/OIDC, RBAC, SSO.
- **Important (headline):** MCP (Model Context Protocol), Agents & tool use, Guardrails, Change management & adoption, LLM gateways, Coding-agent rollout, Pilots & adoption measurement.
- **Full inventory:** 51 skills (Must 4 · Important 14 · Should 22 · Optional 11), each with its evidence and posting keywords: [ai-enablement-engineer.md](../../03-skills-and-tech/inventories/ai-enablement-engineer.md).
- **Prerequisites:** Backend/DevEx engineers; a non-technical ops lane exists (~7 months) [D · T0-06]
- What to learn first and what to drop across roles: [skills radar](../../03-skills-and-tech/skills-radar.md); in what order: [learning roadmaps](../../03-skills-and-tech/learning-roadmaps.md).

## How to prove it

- **What the evidence asks for:** An internal pilot with 5–10 colleagues measuring adoption and time saved, with a runbook and a risk register
- **Project archetypes that cover the most of its Must and Important skills** (Grade M): [P15 Internal AI-enablement pilot (MCP servers, adoption metrics)](../../05-portfolio/project-archetypes.md#p15) (85%); [P2 Reliable agent: approvals, sandboxed tools, replay, failure injection](../../05-portfolio/project-archetypes.md#p2) (38%); [P6 Self-hosted LLM platform on Kubernetes](../../05-portfolio/project-archetypes.md#p6) (31%). One project rarely covers a role; [job-search strategy §2.6](../../06-job-search/job-search-strategy.md#26-the-constraints-that-bind-first) computes the smallest sets that do.
- How verifiable the proof must be, and what to publish: [proof-of-work standards](../../05-portfolio/proof-of-work-standards.md).

## How you are interviewed

- **Track: Application.** It tests RAG with access control, agent loop control, evaluation architecture, context management. Source: career/02-roles/role-catalog.md §8.2 (T1-03, T0-14).
- **Practise:** the [application prep pack](../../08-interviewing/prep-packs.md#application-pack), plus the behavioural and coding packs.
- Classify the loop first, then prepare by round: [interview loops](../../08-interviewing/interview-loops.md).

## Résumé

- **Variant:** A1 (Applied GenAI Engineering). Headline pattern: "AI Engineer | LLM systems, RAG, agents, evals".
- **Keywords to mirror, only when true:** AI enablement, MCP, internal tools, copilot, developer productivity, adoption
- **Leave out or reframe:** Adoption claims without usage or time-saved numbers
